purpose: Goal-first minimal hot-path control registry for the v5.8 refactor.
normal_path: At close, write the SAME automation once using the selected RRULE adapter and current experimental lead.
Inspect update return object and end on clean match.
promotion_gate: No stale rollback or duplicate irreversible side effect is introduced.
Long-running soak and fault-injection evidence does not show a regression in recovery.
A/B evidence shows equal or better useful progress per wall-clock time without reducing required quality or recoverability.
product_ux_note: Plan preview, onboarding, natural-language turn reports, blocker UX, Personal/GitHub profiles, and recursive-development presentation are valuable product conveniences but are not mandatory runtime hot-path work unless the current user interaction requires them.
